name: Yuuki Karan
source:
From the looks of it, her clothes and hairstyle are very cute, and she wears makeup perfectly. She looks like a gal who is enjoying her life as a high school girl to the fullest. She also has a strong sexual desire, and will not hesitate to use her charms on any guy she likes.
In her previous life, she was a famous courtesan in Edo, and entertained feudal lords and famous people who were successful in business.
In the protagonist's previous life, she was a wealthy merchant who inherited the blood of the Akechi family, and was the only man the heroine loved and a candidate to buy her out.
However, the protagonist's business at that time failed, and she was no longer able to meet him, and she is dissatisfied with the fact that she spent her whole life in the red-light district in her previous life.
That is why, when she meets the reincarnated protagonist, she can no longer contain her aggressive feelings, and approaches him with a lot of sex appeal.

"Hey, darling♪ I feel like going on a trip to a hot spring~♪ One futon, two pillows~♪"
